[P2] 儿童情绪管理与性格培养绘本

伊莱家的谎言机
一个说实话的故事
Eli's Lie-O-Meter
A Story About Telling the Truth
[美] 桑德拉·莱文斯（Sandra Levins）著
[美] 杰弗里·艾伯乐（Jeffery Ebbeler）绘
微笑 译
化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P3] 等伊莱长大了，他想要飞翔！
他是多么喜爱飞机和火箭啊！
伊莱还画了色彩缤纷的宇宙飞船，妈妈把这些画镶在框里，挂在书房的墙上。

有时伊莱会戴上游泳眼镜，
假扮成一名开喷气式战斗机的飞行员，然后和副驾驶达菲一块儿
飞上好几个小时。

[P4] 他们力大无比又英勇善战，而且，还总能在饭点儿赶回家吃晚饭。
柯顿是伊莱的第一个伙伴儿，也是最好的朋友，他有时搭乘特制的航天飞机穿越银河系。

[P5] 可是，伊莱遇到了一个麻烦。
自打邮递员送来了那个超高级的谎言机，他就开始有麻烦了。
这玩意儿看起来跟普通的座钟没什么两样，可只要有人说了谎话，钟上的灯就会猛闪，指针狂转，接着吐出一张纸条儿，上面标明你说的话里面到底有多少是真的。

[P6] 其实对于假想和真事儿的区别，伊莱还是能分清的。他环游世界或大战海怪，那是假想的，而真事儿就是实际发生的事情。

[P7] 可有时候，把真事儿说出来
对伊莱来说并不那么容易。
现在，家里摆着这么个谎言机，伊莱的麻烦变得超级大了。
不管是微不足道的小谎，还是荒唐无比的弥天大谎，都能被谎言机精确地检测出来。

[P8] 星期一，爸爸让伊莱去收拾散在地上的积木，他立马提醒爸爸：“最后一个玩积木的是麦迪逊。”
谎言机马上亮灯，转盘飞旋，接着弹出一张“小谎券”。

[P9] 星期二，临睡前妈妈问伊莱：“你刷牙了吗？”
“刷了。”伊莱回答。
那谎言机又是噘嘴，又是气急败坏，
噼啪乱响，一张“谎话券”像舌头似地伸了出来。

[P10] 周五早晨，麦迪逊要去上幼儿园，妈妈准备给她带点纸杯蛋糕。
“谁吃了纸杯蛋糕？我明明记得做了十二个呀。”麦迪逊耸了耸肩，表示一无所知。
伊莱飞快地抹去嘴边的蛋糕碎渣儿，说：“呃，不是我。”谎言机顿时吧嗒作响，还叹着气。
妈妈从地上捡起纸条儿。“伊莱，这可是张‘大谎券’呢，”妈妈说，“小伙子，我可真希望这些券儿能废物利用。咱家已经有一大堆‘谎话券’了！

[P11] 此后伊莱一直开心不起来。他觉得偷吃蛋糕
确实不像话，又不满意自己说了谎，全家人餐后
吃蛋糕的时候也没有他的份儿，这让伊莱好失望。
这个谎言机可真讨人烦。

[P12] 星期六，伊莱和达菲在客厅里扔橄榄球玩。其实伊莱很清楚不应该在屋子里玩传接球，可妈妈这会儿在书房里，谁会知道他在玩传接球呀。
嗯，是没人知道，直到“啪”的一声响！妈妈喊：“伊莱，出什么事儿了？”
“是达菲把灯给打翻啦。”“啊呀，糟糕！”妈妈嚷嚷起来，“达菲，我非常非常爱你。可从现在开始，你必须给我待到屋子外头去！”

[P13] 这套嫁祸于人的谎话瞒过了妈妈，伊莱起初好不得意。可他忽然想到了谎言机，这可是一个弥天大谎啊！
不可思议的是，谎言机这次居然没有识破他的谎话。但那一夜，伊莱念念不忘平日睡在床脚边的达菲。

[P14] 第二天一早，伊莱去厨房找爸爸妈妈。
“爸爸妈妈，我想说说那个台灯的事儿……”
接着他把实情一五一十地讲了出来。
这时，谎言机动静很大，像是要爆炸似的，指针击中了“真话”标记，接着送出了一张尺寸超大的“真话券”！

[P15] 爸爸说：“伊莱，我们理解你的行为，因为没有人愿意让自己惹上麻烦，可如果你的谎话让无辜的人或者小狗受了冤枉，那就很不公平了。”
妈妈说：“你能想明白并说出真相，我和爸爸为你感到自豪。你的勇敢和诚实，我们都看到了。从今天起100年里你都实话实说，好吗？”
伊莱明白，100年就意味着永远。
他同意了：“遵命，机长！”

[P16] Abracadabra
Hocus Pocus
make the truth this family's focus
妈妈拾起“真话券”，发现背面印着字，她大声读了出来：变——变——变，讲默认设置变真话！

[P17] 正念着，谎言机突然激烈地晃动起来，嘎吱作响，汽笛嘟嘟，灯光闪闪，表盘转个不停，最后“扑通”一声，喧闹静止了。伊莱把眼睛瞪得大大的，凑近机器仔细端详。

[P18] “哇！”伊莱惊叫起来，“它变样儿了，变成真话机了！怎么回事呀？
妈妈说：“我也不清楚怎么回事儿。不过我喜欢‘真话’，可我看咱家用不着检测这个。”
妈妈对伊莱眨了眨眼，推开了过道门，达菲蹦跳着冲回屋里。

[P2] Children's Emotional Management and Character Development Picture Book
Volume 4: Growing Up
Eli's Lie-O-Meter
A Story About Telling the Truth
[USA] Sandra Levins (Sandra Levins) Author
[USA] Jeffery Ebbeler (Jeffery Ebbeler) Illustrator
Translated by Wei Xiao
Chemical Industry Press
·Beijing·

[P3] When Eli grew up, he wanted to fly!
He loved airplanes and rockets so much!
Eli also drew colorful spaceships, and Mom put these drawings in frames and hung them on the wall in the study.

Sometimes Eli would put on swimming goggles,
pretend to be a pilot flying a jet fighter, and then fly for hours with his co-pilot, Daffy.

[P4] They are incredibly strong and brave warriors, and always manage to get home for dinner on time.
Cotton is Ilay's first companion and best friend; sometimes he rides a custom-made spaceship across the galaxy.

[P5] But Eli had a problem.
Ever since the mailman delivered that super-advanced lie detector, he'd been having trouble.
This gadget looked just like an ordinary mantel clock, but whenever someone told a lie, the lights on the clock would flash wildly, the needle would spin, and then it would spit out a slip of paper showing exactly how much of what you said was true.

[P6] Actually, Eli can still tell the difference between imagination and real events. Sailing around the world or battling sea monsters is imagination, while real events are things that actually happen.

[P7] Sometimes, telling the truth
wasn't easy for Ilay.
Now, with this lie detector at home, Ilay's troubles became huge.
Whether it was a tiny little lie or a ridiculous, huge lie, the lie detector could detect it precisely.

[P8] Monday, Dad asked Ilay to clean up the blocks scattered on the floor. He immediately reminded Dad, "The last one who played with the blocks was Madison." 
The lie detector immediately lit up, its dial spun, and then it ejected a "small lie coupon."

[P9] Tuesday, before bedtime, Mom asked Eli, "Did you brush your teeth?"
"Brushed it," Eli answered.
The lie detector machine pouted again, fuming with anger,
jangling wildly, and a "lie ticket" popped out like a tongue.

[P10] Friday morning, Madison was going to kindergarten, and Mom was preparing some cupcakes for her.
"Who ate the cupcakes? I clearly remember making twelve," Madison shrugged, showing she had no idea.
Eli quickly wiped the cake crumbs from his mouth and said, "Uh, not me." The lie detector immediately clicked and sighed.
Mom picked up the slip from the floor. "Eli, this is a 'Big Lie Ticket,'" Mom said, "Kid, I really hope we can recycle these tickets. We already have a huge pile of 'Lie Tickets'!"

[P11] After this, Ilay couldn't be happy anymore. He felt it was wrong to sneak the cake,
and he also disliked having told a lie. When the whole family ate cake after dinner,
there was no portion for him, which made Ilay very disappointed.
This lie detector was really annoying.

[P12] Saturday, Ilay and Dafi were playing catch with a football in the living room. Actually, Ilay knew very well that he shouldn't play catch inside the house, but Mom was in the study right now. Who would know he was playing catch?
Well, no one did, until *thud*! Mom shouted, "Ilay, what's going on?"
"Dafi knocked over the lamp!" "Oh no, terrible!" Mom yelled, "Dafi, I love you very much. But from now on, you must stay outside the house!"

[P13] This lie, blaming someone else, fooled Mom, and Eli was initially very pleased. But then he suddenly thought of the lie detector—this was a huge lie!
Incredibly, the lie detector didn’t catch his lie this time. But that night, Eli couldn’t stop thinking about Daffy, who usually slept by the foot of his bed.

[P14] The next morning, Ilay went to the kitchen to find his parents.
"Mom and Dad, I want to talk about the lamp incident..."
Then he told the whole truth.
At that moment, the lie detector made a big noise, as if about to explode, its needle hit the "Truth" mark, and then it dispensed a giant-sized "Truth Ticket"!

[P15] Dad said: "Eli, we understand your behavior, because no one wants to get into trouble, but if your lies make an innocent person or a dog suffer unfairly, that's very unfair." 
Mom said: "You were able to understand and tell the truth. Dad and I are proud of you. Your bravery and honesty, we've all seen. From today on, for 100 years, you'll always tell the truth, okay?" 
Eli understood: 100 years meant forever. 
He agreed: "Aye, Captain!"

[P16] Abracadabra
Hocus Pocus
make the truth this family's focus
Mom picked up the 'Truth Coupon', found writing on the back, and read it aloud: Abra—abra—abra, set the default to truth!

[P17] Just as he was reciting, the Lie-O-Meter suddenly began to shake violently, creaking, honking, flashing lights, its dial spinning wildly, until with a final 'thump,' the noise ceased. Eli widened his eyes and leaned in to examine the machine closely.

[P18] "Wow!" Ili exclaimed, "It's changed! It's become a truth machine! What's going on?"
Mom said, "I'm not sure what's happening. But I like 'truth'—I don't think we need to detect it in our home."
Mom winked at Ili, opened the passageway door, and Daffy bounced back into the house.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《伊莱家的谎言机》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者及出版社等信息，画面中一个孩子驾驶着红色玩具车，周围有纸币和装饰物，整体风格活泼，主题围绕诚实与成长。
[P2] 本页为绘本《伊莱家的谎言机》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者及出版社信息，画面中有一个蒸汽朋克风格的谎言检测仪和飘散的纸币，整体风格奇幻且富有童趣。
[P3] 本页描绘了伊莱对飞行的向往，他喜爱飞机和火箭，画了许多宇宙飞船，妈妈将画作装裱挂在书房，并常与他的玩具达菲一起假装驾驶战斗机飞行。
[P4] 本页描绘了伊莱的想象世界，他与朋友柯顿一起在宇宙中冒险，柯顿乘坐航天飞机穿越银河系，而伊莱的家人则在家中准备晚餐，画面充满奇幻与温馨的对比。
[P5] 伊莱收到了一个超高级的谎言机，它能检测谎言并显示话语中真实的比例，从此他开始遇到麻烦。
[P6] 本页通过文字说明伊莱能区分想象与现实，配图描绘了他想象中驾驶帆船与海怪搏斗的奇幻场景，呼应了前文他丰富的想象力。
[P7] 本页文字说明伊莱因家中有了能检测谎言的机器而感到困扰，即使说小谎也会被发现，画面描绘了伊莱和家人在厨房中进行充满想象力的“航海”游戏，水花四溅，充满童趣。
[P8] 星期一，伊莱在收拾积木时向爸爸指出是麦迪逊最后一个玩积木，谎言机随即检测出这是小谎并弹出“小谎券”，展现了谎言机对日常小事的敏感反应。
[P9] 星期二晚上，妈妈问伊莱是否刷牙，伊莱回答‘刷了’，谎言机随即反应激烈，弹出一张‘谎话券’，显示他对日常小事的诚实也受到机器的检测。
[P10] 周五早晨，妈妈发现纸杯蛋糕少了，麦迪逊不知情，伊莱否认吃了蛋糕，谎言机检测出他撒了谎并发出警告，妈妈捡起‘大谎券’感叹家里已积攒大量谎言券。
[P11] 伊莱因偷吃蛋糕被谎言机揭穿而感到内疚和失望，全家吃蛋糕时他没有份，他觉得谎言机非常讨厌。
[P12] 星期六，伊莱和达菲在客厅玩橄榄球，不小心打翻了灯。妈妈发现后，虽然表示爱达菲，但仍要求他离开屋子。
[P13] 伊莱将打翻灯的责任推给达菲，成功瞒过妈妈，但想到谎言机未检测出谎言而感到不安，同时惦记着平日陪伴他的宠物达菲。
[P14] 伊莱在第二天一早向父母坦白了打翻台灯的真相，谎言机检测到他说真话后，发出巨大声响并弹出一张超大的“真话券”。
[P15] 伊莱向父母坦白打翻台灯的真相后，父母肯定了他的诚实，鼓励他今后100年都讲真话，伊莱欣然接受并承诺遵守。
[P16] 妈妈拾起伊莱坦白后获得的‘真话券’，发现背面有魔法咒语，她大声念出咒语，将家庭的默认设置改为‘真话’。
[P17] 妈妈念出魔法咒语后，谎言机剧烈反应，发出各种声响并最终静止，伊莱惊讶地凑近观察机器。
[P18] 伊莱发现谎言机变成真话机后感到惊讶，妈妈表示喜欢‘真话’并认为家中无需检测，随后打开门让宠物达菲跑回屋里。
[P19] 画面描绘了一个秋日街景：一个小女孩打着伞走在人行道上，一只穿着背带的黑色小狗在草地上挖土；背景中有骑踏板车的人、行人、汽车、垃圾桶和远处的机器人，整体色调温暖，充满生活气息。
[P20] 画面描绘了一个秋日街景：一个小女孩打着绿色雨伞走在人行道上，穿着彩色围巾和棕色外套，脚踩绿色雨靴，面带微笑；背景中可见部分车辆、路灯和建筑物，整体色调温暖，充满生活气息。
